question: Under which reported conditions does nisin inhibit Listeria monocytogenes?

source.title: Synthetic demonstration record for schema validation

source_documents.text: In a broth microdilution assay, 10^6 CFU/mL Listeria monocytogenes ATCC 19115 in BHI broth was exposed to nisin at 2.5 mg/L for 90 minutes at pH 6.5 and 37 °C. The MIC of nisin was 2.5 mg/L.
